title: The Goblin Band
objective: Clear the goblin band out of the mill storeroom.

rooms.name: Mill Storeroom
rooms.description: Flour sacks are slit open across the floor, and the air is white with dust. Two goblins look up from their plunder.

opponents.description: A wiry goblin minion licks flour from its dagger.
Behind it a goblin warrior in patched leather barks orders and draws its scimitar.

endings.title: The storeroom is clear
endings.text: The last goblin drops among the torn sacks. The miller can count what is left of the harvest.

endings.title: Fallen in the flour
endings.text: You fall among the flour sacks. Your adventuring ends here.
